t: What the ordinary acts wipe out
a: فِتْنَةُ الرَّجُلِ فِي أَهْلِهِ وَمَالِهِ وَوَلَدِهِ وَجَارِهِ تُكَفِّرُهَا الصَّلاَةُ وَالصَّوْمُ وَالصَّدَقَةُ وَالأَمْرُ وَالنَّهْىُ
p: Fitnatu-r-rajuli fī ahlihi wa mālihi wa waladihi wa jārihi tukaffiruhā-ṣ-ṣalātu wa-ṣ-ṣawmu wa-ṣ-ṣadaqatu wa-l-amru wa-n-nahy
m: A man's trial in his family, his wealth, his child and his neighbour is wiped out by the prayer, the fasting, the charity, and enjoining good and forbidding wrong.
